benchmark.unit_of_evaluation: 24 h window ending at the end of each simulated day (14 per run); label 1 if a theft-like event is active >= 12 of the 24 h, 0 if none, windows with 1-11 active hours are excluded

localisation.definition: share of evaluation windows with at least one theft-like event in which the highest-scoring feeder (or DT) is one that actually contains the event

delay.definition: hours from event onset to the first evaluation time (on a grid of every 3 h) at which the method flags the affected consumer (B/D), DT (C) or feeder; events never flagged during their window count as missed.

energy_balance_recovery.definition: recovered = unexplained(scenario C) - unexplained(same seed, normal operation) over an 8-day window; ratio = recovered / injected unmetered energy. Feeder ratio > 1 is expected because the unmetered load also causes extra technical losses that the loss estimate cannot see.
